content:
alex: heads up — saw a big spike in remote_write queue depth for prometheus in west2-gpu around 02:10 UTC; p95 remote_write latency jumped to ~8s and we're getting scrape 5xxs from a bunch of gpu-exporter pods. logs show KV cache memory growth on the scrapers. 

maya: ops-bot just fired the alert?

ops-bot: ALERT: prometheus.remote_write.queue_depth > 1000 (cluster=west2-gpu)

sam: can you paste the logs? is it exporter flapping or prometheus backpressure?

alex: dumping a snippet — prometheus logs: 

```
level=warn ts=2026-03-18T02:09:52.123Z caller=remote.go:230 component=remote msg="remote write failed" status=504 err="write tcp 10.2.3.4:443: i/o timeout"
level=info ts=2026-03-18T02:10:01.987Z caller=scrape.go:867 component=scrape job=gpu-exporter target=pod/gpu-exporter-abc-123 msg="Scrape failed" err="unexpected status code 503"
level=debug ts=2026-03-18T02:10:02.111Z caller=memory.go:45 component=storage msg="kv cache items" items=272394
```

maya: that items number is huge. we normally see <10k. something's creating unique series per scrape.

jin: likely relabeling introduced a high-cardinality label; last deploy to k8s had a relabeler tweak for pod name -> instance. anyone touched scrape relabel_configs?

sam: i updated the gpu-exporter service discovery relabels in the last rollout to include pod_name as `instance` for easier per-pod debugging. that might be it.

alex: can you show the relabel snippet?

sam: quick paste: 

```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
    target_label: instance
    regex: (.*)
    replacement: $1
    action: replace
```

maya: yep. that sets instance to full pod name (unique per pod), combined with gpu index labels from exporter probably created new series for every GPU + timestamp variance => cardinality explosion.

jin: recommended fix: stop adding pod-unique labels or canonicalize. either drop instance label or rewrite to service-level id. e.g. change regex to `^([^-]+)` to keep only deployment name, or use `action: labeldrop` for pod label.

alex: quick mitigation — i'm going to patch Prometheus scrape config to drop `instance` label before it hits TSDB and restart scrapers with rolling restart to avoid high memory churn. also increase remote_write timeout and enable backoff splay. planning steps: 
- add relabel_config: `{action: labeldrop, regex: instance}` on gpu-exporter job
- set scrape_timeout to 10s -> currently it was 5s and got tight
- reduce scrape_interval jitter temporarily to smooth spikes? maybe set scrape_interval 30s -> 60s for heavy exporters

sam: please also add a temporary recording rule to count series cardinality per job: 
```
- record: job:series_count:sum
  expr: count({job=~"gpu-exporter.*"}) by (job)
```
so we can watch reduction after patch.

maya: note — if we drop the label, dashboards that depend on per-pod instance will be impacted. we should warn SRE and platform channels and have a follow-up to reintroduce lower-cardinality identifiers for debugging.

ops-bot: NOTE: planned config change by alex at 02:18 UTC — prometheus config reload requested

alex: applying patch now (kubectl patch configmap prometheus-scrape -n monitoring --type merge -p ...) then rolling restart of prometheus-scrape pods.

sam: i'll watch remote_write queue and grafana panels. keeping an eye on p95 and queue_length.

jin: after we stabilize, we should also add a k8s relabel rule in the exporter SD to avoid including `pod_template_hash` and pod-unique labels. common pattern: use `__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app` instead of `__meta_kubernetes_pod_name` for non-unique.

maya: and add an alert for rapid kv cache growth: `increase(prometheus_tsdb_cache_memory_bytes[5m]) > X` — that'll catch runaway cache growth before queue hits 1k.

alex: patch applied and reload done. prometheus pods reloaded at 02:18:42 UTC.

ops-bot: CONFIG RELOAD: prometheus-reload success at 02:18:43 UTC

sam: early signs: queue_depth dropping from 1200 -> 240 over 2m. p95 remote_write down to 1.2s.

alex: good. leaving the temporary drop in place for 2 hours then we reconvene. will open a follow-up PR to change relabeling in the k8s service discovery to a less granular instance value and add docs. :white_check_mark:

jin: follow-up TODOs: 
- add cardinality recording rules (sam)
- alert for KV cache growth (maya)
- update exporter SD relabel in repo and ensure QA (alex/sam)

maya: logging note — we should correlate exporter logs to kubelet eviction events; there were a few pod restart spikes in the same window. could be flapping + relabeled identity created transient series that persisted causing memory churn.

alex: opening ops-ticket: OT-4824 with timeline and config diff.

sam: thanks all. monitoring for 30m and then revert to normal scrape_interval.

maya: great runbook addition — add a short section in runbooks/prometheus-cardinality.md about "don't create pod-unique labels from SD" and examples.

alex: will do. :rocket:
